A Classic Vietnamese Pho in a Luxury Setting
Mar 2026 • Family
This morning I had the chance to try pho at a restaurant inside a five-star hotel. The atmosphere was elegant and quiet, which made the experience feel quite relaxing. The bowl of pho was presented very nicely, with everything arranged neatly.

The broth was clear and aromatic, with a gentle flavor from long-simmered bones and subtle spices. It wasn’t overly strong, but rather light and refined, which made it very pleasant to eat. The rice noodles were soft, and the beef was fresh and nicely sliced. The portion looked tidy but was still satisfying.

What I appreciated most was the attention to detail: fresh herbs, well-prepared condiments, quick service, and very polite staff. It felt like enjoying a familiar bowl of pho, but in a much more refined setting.

Of course, the price is higher than street pho, but the overall experience, atmosphere, and service are what you would expect from a five-star hotel. Overall, it was a very enjoyable breakfast. 🍜✨
